evidence.detail: The class recognizes @type@, <type>, <type=N> and </type> markers; default type delay is 75 ms and explicit delay is clamped to 10..2000 ms.

Its preprocessing path rewrites typing markers into timestamped <type=delay:startMillis> form using System.nanoTime()/1_000_000 and records the expected completion deadline from visible-character count.
The static parser returns the currently revealable character count as floor((now-start)/delay)+1, returns a dedicated close-tag sentinel for </type>, and rejects malformed timing metadata.

Exact-v308 reverse references are limited to Client, R55 RSFont and R418 RichTextStyleParser. Client preprocesses displayed strings through this class, RSFont consults its type-tag parser during live glyph traversal, and Client checks the effect-completion latch to force redraw while typing is active.
The class owns only typing-effect timing/completion state and markup parsing; other rich-text color, flashing, particle and sprite effects remain in separate recovered classes.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the timed character-reveal rich-text effect implemented by <type> markup. No original stripped source identifier is claimed.
